memo: TPU training, no submit. dn1tpu-1 overfit (held-out loss best 0.8149 at epoch 7, then up to 0.8919; train loss 0.54->0.42 = memorising canonical SMILES). dn1tpu-2 adds ours: (1) randomized-SMILES augmentation (idea: Arus-Pous et al. 2019, J Cheminform 11:71; 8 strings per structure, stereo kept, half of rows per epoch use a random string), (2) dn1.pt keeps only the best held-out epoch (mid-epoch saves go to dn1_last.pt). Continues from dn1-1b, 30 epochs, 1.7 h cap. Pass: dn1r truth generated >= 0.15 and valid >= 0.35 -> e3dn20 with these weights.
message: dn1tpu-2: dn1 training on TPU v5e-8 with randomized-SMILES augmentation + best-epoch checkpoint
